_basis: Assumptions, not measurements: what share of the time a conditional bonus is on. The first row that matches a clause counts; no match means it is always on (100%). Change a share here and the Stated percent ranking follows. The states are the conditions sampled in game (lgw_measure.js 3c): the size of a curio's effect in a state is measured, the share of the time a player is in it is an assumption set here.

items.why: Builds up with hits or kills: half counted
Works with one weapon type: 30% counted
Works on one kind of target: 30% counted

items.re: \b(?:below|above|under|over|when|while|if|during|after|upon|on kill|on hit|at night|underwater|in water|on sand|standing|sneaking|sprinting|airborne|mid-jump|full health|low health)\b

lowhp.why: Below a fifth of your health: counted a quarter of the time

night.why: At night: counted a third of the time

burning.why: While you burn: counted a tenth of the time

sprint.why: While sprinting: counted 40% of the time

zombie.why: Against undead: counted 30% of the time

tburn.why: Against a burning target: counted 15% of the time

tlow.why: Against a target at a fifth of its health: counted a quarter of the time
